integrity: Analytic proof is supplemented by reproducible finite numerical checks. General first-integral equations and the constant-core optimum are acknowledged as prior work; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary mean-field two-velocity PDE classification under imposed monotone phase branches, fixed interface flux and symmetric single-core geometry; no microscopic existence, full phase selection or dynamic stability.
title: Gas-independent droplet geometry and power-law optimal resetting in active matter
